Transport

Framing for codepoints that exceed 31 bits.

Because plugin codepoints exceed 31 bits, Extended defines its own transport families over sucs_ex_char_t (64-bit). Base SUTF8/16/32 cap at 0x7FFFFFFF; these do not.

Transport Description Reference
Vector Length-prefixed sequences of 64-bit codepoints; one codepoint per unit, little-endian. vsutf.h / vector layout
vsutf Variable-length integer framing (LEB128-style) covering the full 64-bit space. vsutf.h
e-SUST The fixed-base Extended family complementing Base SUTF8/16/32, plus page-mapped IPC framing. esust.h (SUST module)

Why separate framing?

  • Base SUTF is optimized for 31-bit codepoints and the Unicode Compatibility Space.
  • Plugin codepoints can be any value up to 2^64-1; variable-length framing keeps common values small.
  • The vector layout gives zero-cost random access at the cost of 8 bytes per unit — the right trade for in-memory streams.

Specified in SUTR-4 — ExtSUCS Transport; data files under Public/0.1.0/transport/.
